description: This file defines the PgSQL class, a database abstraction layer for PostgreSQL within the Opencart system. It manages database connections, executes queries, escapes strings, and handles retrieving last inserted IDs.

classes.name: PgSQL
classes.description: A class providing methods to connect to a PostgreSQL database, execute queries, and manage database interactions

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection using provided options, throws exception if essential parameters are missing or connection fails

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and returns the result as an object containing row, rows, and num_rows properties

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe SQL inclusion

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from a sequence

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the database connection is active

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed
